structured.answer: The page says to open the account at פסגות and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)": 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month would leave 86,045 ₪ after 10 years (70,000 ₪ put in), but that uses the site's own 7% example and I don't know these firms, so I'd ask my son before doing anything.
